{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Dreaded Shyrack''''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was a rival of the ''[[Scorching Pulsar]]''. The two destroyed each other in a shootout during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], prompting scavengers to raid the vessels for their treasure.
